name: Corn and Sprout Chaat
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: ½ cup sweet corn kernels, boiled
½ tsp chaat masala and ¼ tsp chilli powder
steps: Boil the corn for 6 minutes and steam the sprouts for 4 minutes; drain and cool slightly.
Combine with the chickpeas, onion, tomato and coriander.
Add the lemon juice, chaat masala, chilli powder and chutney.
note: Using sprouts and chickpeas alongside the corn keeps protein up and the carbohydrate load moderate.
